news.headline: Apple Vision Pro sees surge in enterprise adoption across Fortune 500
news.summary: Multiple Fortune 500 companies are deploying Apple Vision Pro for training, design visualization, and remote collaboration. Enterprise orders have exceeded Apple's internal projections by 40%.

news.headline: Google faces landmark antitrust ruling — potential forced divestiture of Chrome
news.summary: Federal judge is considering structural remedies in the Google antitrust case, including potential forced sale of Chrome browser. This could significantly impact Alphabet's advertising ecosystem.

news.headline: Tesla FSD v12.5 achieves record safety metrics in NHTSA evaluation
news.summary: Tesla's Full Self-Driving version 12.5 recorded 0 disengagements over 10,000 test miles in NHTSA supervised testing, marking a significant milestone for autonomous driving technology.

news.headline: Microsoft Azure AI revenue surpasses $10B annual run rate
news.summary: Microsoft disclosed that Azure AI services have crossed $10B in ARR, driven by Copilot enterprise adoption and growing OpenAI integration. Cloud margins expanded 200bps.

news.headline: Amazon AWS Bedrock becomes fastest-growing AWS service ever
news.summary: AWS Bedrock, Amazon's managed AI service, has become the fastest service to reach $1B in revenue in AWS history. Enterprise customers are rapidly migrating ML workloads to the platform.

news.headline: Federal Reserve signals potential rate cuts amid cooling inflation
news.summary: Fed Chair hinted at potential rate cuts starting Q2 2024 as PCE inflation falls below 2.5%. Market reactions broadly positive across tech and growth sectors.

news.headline: China's economic slowdown weighs on Apple iPhone sales in Asia-Pacific
news.summary: Apple's iPhone sales in China fell 7% QoQ amid intensifying competition from Huawei and economic headwinds. Analysts warn this could pressure hardware margins in upcoming quarters.

news.headline: Tesla Cybertruck production hits 2,500 units per week milestone
news.summary: Giga Texas Cybertruck line reached 2,500 units/week, ahead of schedule. Backlog remains at 1.5M reservations. Margin breakeven now expected by Q2 rather than Q3.

news.headline: Alphabet CEO warns AI costs will remain elevated through 2025
news.summary: Sundar Pichai cautioned investors that AI infrastructure capex will remain elevated, with $30B+ planned for 2024. While necessary for competitive positioning, this pressures near-term margins.

news.headline: Amazon Prime Video ad tier surpasses 50 million subscribers globally
news.summary: Amazon's ad-supported Prime Video tier has exceeded 50M subscribers, generating an estimated $3B annual advertising revenue. This validates Amazon's entry into the streaming advertising market.
